what: Electrical profile and interface check for the bonded PET LED leaf variant (R4 item 5, #19): a clear PET film laminated with OCA to a 0.8 mm clear PC carrier, as compared by R2 in PR #35 (engineering/a7/mechanical/layout.md, 'LED leaf: FR-4 (default) versus clear PET FPC on a clear carrier'). A profile and a check of the A5 leaf circuit and copper against it, not a leaf design.
default_note: The A5 FR-4 leaf stays the default and fallback. Nothing here selects PET, approves a PET process or releases anything for manufacture; JLC's PET answers (Q11) and the physical mating-force and lit-appearance tests (#10) are still open.

reference.note: The PET variant keeps the A5 leaf circuit, outline (82.5 x 9.0), LED and SH4 positions. Its netlist contract is the A5 leaf netlist under the reviewed role map; the A5 copper is the only layout that exists, so it is what the rules below are checked against.

interface.note: Controller J3 -> left leaf J1, left leaf J2 -> right leaf J1 over two straight 1:1 SH4 harnesses (scripts/native_gate/interface.py harness()).

mechanical.note: R2's 3HP PET export: LED, SH4 and harness start within 0.01 mm of the FR-4 positions; leaf Z range unchanged.

stack.note: Two films (one per face) on one carrier, as R2 modelled. Stack = 2 x film + 2 x OCA + carrier.

pet_1layer.source: src-a7-jlc-flex-capabilities (1-layer transparent 0.14 mm; single-sided copper 18/35 um)
pet_1layer.note: The stack R2 modelled (1.28 mm, 0.16 mm cap slot clearance per side).

pet_2layer.source: src-a7-jlc-flex-capabilities (2-layer transparent 0.24 mm; double-sided copper 12/18/35 um)
pet_2layer.note: Not modelled by R2. Stack 1.48 mm against the 1.60 mm slot implied by R2's 1.28 mm + 2 x 0.16 mm, i.e. 0.06 mm per side on paper; R2 must re-check before this is used.

min_track_mm.note: 3.5 mil at 18 um copper (3/3 mil at 12 um, 4/4 mil at 35 um)

coverlay_opening_to_trace_mm.note: With the 0.1 mm coverlay expansion an exposed pad needs >= 0.25 mm to any other track. Measured on the A5 leaf by native DRC with a pad-to-track rule: no hit at 0.25 mm; the minimum is 0.30 mm (J1/J2 MP pads to the nearest track). Met; recorded here, not encoded as a verdict.

pth_annular_ring_mm.note: The A5 leaf vias (0.6/0.3) have a 0.15 mm ring and fail this row if JLC applies it to vias as well as component holes. Recorded under Q11e, not encoded as a verdict.

rules.smt_only_source: engineering/a7/pet-fpc.md (THT and wave soldering on PET not stated; leaf must stay SMT-only)

current_bound.what: Worst-case shared VLED current: the TPS2552 short-circuit limit with the controller's ILIM resistor. The left leaf carries both leaves' current (its J2 feeds the right leaf), so every leaf power segment is checked at this bound.
current_bound.firmware_cap_note: The firmware code<=51 PWM cap is a commanded cap, not a supply-current limit (engineering/a5/firmware/README.md), so it is not used as the bound.

copper_resistivity_ohm_m.note: annealed copper at 20 C; ENIG and temperature rise not counted

expected.note: Recorded verdicts of the current A5 copper against this profile. The check fails when a fresh verdict differs, so a change to the profile, the rules or the reference cannot pass silently. NOT_MET is a finding, not a gate failure.

open_questions_ref: engineering/a7/open-questions.md Q11d (1-layer cannot carry the A5 copper), Q11e (plated vias on 2-layer transparent PET), Q11f (0.2 mm coverlay bridges vs the 0.5 mm minimum); blocking for the PET variant only, not for the FR-4 default
open: JLC: are plated vias offered on 2-layer transparent PET (the A5 leaf routes all data on B.Cu through 11 vias), and does the PTH annular ring row (>= 0.18 mm absolute) apply to vias (the A5 vias have 0.15 mm)?
JLC: coverlay bridges under 0.5 mm are removed, so the WS2812B-2020 and SH4 pads share coverlay openings; is that acceptable for assembly, or is a LPI/transparent solder mask offered on PET?
JLC Q11 items 1-7 in engineering/a7/pet-fpc.md (reflow profile, operating temperature, stiffeners, part classes, OCA clarity, transparent coverlay transmittance, separate FR-4 order).
SH4 header retention on film over a PC carrier: only the two SMD MP pads hold it; the SH mating force is unsourced (R2) and needs the #10 physical test.
SH4 contact current rating: the JST SH catalog is SOURCE UNAVAILABLE in the SM04B-SRSS-TB owner bundle.

sources.evidence_extract: Minimum Trace Width/Spacing: 12 um copper 3/3 mil (absolute limit 2/2 mil), 18 um 3.5/3.5 mil, 35 um 4/4 mil. Min. via hole size/diameter regular 0.3 mm/0.55 mm; via diameter at least 0.2 mm larger than the hole. Pad-to-trace: via ring to trace >= 0.1 mm, exposed pad to trace >= 0.15 mm. Copper to board edge >= 0.3 mm. Coverlay expansion (one-sided) 0.1 mm; coverlay opening to trace >= 0.15 mm. Minimum solder bridge width 0.5 mm: a bridge narrower than 0.5 mm will be removed. Outer copper: single-sided 18/35 um; double-sided 12/18/35 um. Coverlay colours include Transparent. Annular Ring for PTH >= 0.25 mm recommended, absolute limit 0.18 mm.
sources.note: Same page as src-a7-jlc-flex-capabilities (R1), retrieved again for the design-rule rows R1 did not extract; the live page hash differs from R1's capture.
